A '''planetoid''' was the site of a [[Mining Guild]] [[Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery|asteroid gas refinery]] during the [[Imperial Era|age]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. This [[planetoid]]'s [[atmosphere]] was covered in [[Clouzon-36]] gas, which was a source of [[Foodstuff|food]] for the [[purrgil]], a [[species]] of large space-dwelling creatures capable of traveling through [[hyperspace]]. About three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the gas refinery was [[Heist at the Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery|raided and destroyed]] by the [[Spectres]] and a herd of purrgil.<ref name="The Call" />
